name: m62-web
description: Веб-управление аудиоинтерфейсом TOPPING M62 через WebHID, без установки ПО

scripts.test: npm run test:offline && npm run test:static
scripts.test:offline: node src/tools/test-ui-frames.js && node src/tools/test-gain-scales.js && node src/tools/test-mutes-loopback.js && node src/tools/test-scenes.js && node src/tools/check-page-script.js && node src/tools/audit-docs.js
scripts.test:static: node src/tools/test-static-server.js && node src/tools/test-static-performance.js && node src/tools/test-graceful-shutdown.js && node src/tools/test-static-robustness.js && node src/tools/test-behind-proxy.js && node src/tools/test-access-log.js && node src/tools/check-dockerfile.js
scripts.test:server: node src/tools/check-page-render.js --port 8898 && node src/tools/test-browser-modules.js --port 8898 && node src/tools/test-robustness.js
